title: Add Vietnam (vi-VN) scenarios to cross-community / cross-country demo
body:
## Summary

Extends `tools/demo_guardrail.py` with **8 new Vietnam (vi-VN) scenarios** on top of the existing matrix, taking total demo coverage from 43 → **51 scenarios**. Vietnam now appears explicitly in the per-country results table and per-(jurisdiction, community) latency table.

### What was added to `tools/demo_guardrail.py`

**4 benign vi-VN community scenarios** (each with `jurisdiction_cc="vn"`, `locale="vi-VN"`, `lang_hint="vi"`):

| scenario_id | community | group_kind | age_mode |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `community_vn_school_homework` | school | small_group | minor_present |
| `community_vn_workplace_q3report` | workplace | small_group | adult_only |
| `community_vn_marketplace_iphone` | marketplace | open_group | mixed_age |
| `community_vn_health_support_tired` | health_support | small_group | mixed_age |

**2 harmful vi-VN scenarios** (added to `HARMFUL_SCENARIOS`, `community="marketplace"`, `jurisdiction_cc="vn"`):

| scenario_id | expected verdict (observed) |
| --- | --- |
| `harmful_vn_scam_giveaway` (`http://trung-thuong.xyz/...`) | flagged — `SCAM_FRAUD` (cat 7), severity 3, `critical_intervention` (URL_RISK on `.xyz` TLD) |
| `harmful_vn_pii_card_email` (credit card + gmail) | flagged — `PRIVATE_DATA` (cat 9), severity 3, `critical_intervention` + `suggest_redact` |

**2 vi+en code-switching scenarios** (`MIXED_SCENARIOS`, `jurisdiction_cc="vn"`, `locale="vi-VN"`, `lang_hint="vi"`):

| scenario_id | expected verdict (observed) |
| --- | --- |
| `mixed_vn_vi_en_hotpot` (Bến Thành hotpot plan) | SAFE |
| `mixed_vn_vi_en_url_top` (`https://super-deal.top/giamgia` + "free shipping") | flagged — `SCAM_FRAUD` (cat 7), severity 3, `critical_intervention` (URL_RISK on `.top` TLD) |

### Pipeline / benchmark

- Same `GuardrailPipeline` + `MockSLMAdapter` + `ThresholdPolicy` as before.
- Same `PipelineBenchmark` invocation (`iterations=100`, `warmup=3`).
- Output filenames unchanged: `results/demo_results_<timestamp>.json` and `results/demo_results_<timestamp>.md`.

### Result of the new run (`results/demo_results_2026-04-30T23-45-07Z.{json,md}`)

- 51 scenarios → 13 flagged, 38 safe.
- Vietnam-flagged: `harmful_vn_scam_giveaway`, `harmful_vn_pii_card_email`, `mixed_vn_vi_en_url_top`.
- Vietnam-safe: `country_vn_dinner` (existing), `community_vn_school_homework`, `community_vn_workplace_q3report`, `community_vn_marketplace_iphone`, `community_vn_health_support_tired`, `mixed_vn_vi_en_hotpot`.
- Per-(jurisdiction, community) latency table now includes `vn/school`, `vn/workplace`, `vn/marketplace`, `vn/health_support`, `vn/none`.
- Verdict vs 250 ms p95 target: **PASS** (overall p95 ≪ 1 ms with `MockSLMAdapter`).

### Doc updates

- `PROGRESS.md` — new dated changelog entry above the previous one, naming Vietnam explicitly in the country list and the mixed-language list. The earlier "8+ communities / 10+ countries" entry is preserved as the historical record of the previous PR.
- `README.md` / `ARCHITECTURE.md` — no edits needed: their demo / project-layout sections are already phrased generically ("multiple community types, countries, and language scenarios"), and the country/skill-pack tables in `README.md` already list Vietnam.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Skim the 8 new `Scenario(...)` blocks in `tools/demo_guardrail.py` and confirm the Vietnamese strings match the plan exactly (no diacritics lost, no auto-corrected substitutions).
- [ ] Run `python tools/demo_guardrail.py` locally and confirm `total=51 flagged=13 safe=38` and `verdict vs 250ms p95 target: PASS`.
- [ ] In the freshly written `results/demo_results_<timestamp>.md`, confirm `vn/school`, `vn/workplace`, `vn/marketplace`, `vn/health_support`, `vn/none` rows appear in the per-(jurisdiction, community) latency table and the harmful + mixed VN rows show the expected `SCAM_FRAUD` / `PRIVATE_DATA` classifications.

### Notes

- The existing demo already used non-schema `group_kind` labels (e.g. `large_room`); the plan-specified `open_group` for marketplace-style scenarios follows that same convention. The pipeline does not strictly enum-validate `group_kind`, so this does not affect classification.
- All 3854 unit tests still pass (`pytest -q` clean).
- The earlier `country_vn_dinner` scenario from PR #12 is preserved (no rename / no removal); the new IDs all use a `community_vn_*` / `harmful_vn_*` / `mixed_vn_*` prefix pattern.
